results.description:
Aurem is a fully customizable digital journal designed to feel personal, real, and entirely unique to you. Choose your cover, materials, fonts, stickers, and even upload your own handwriting to type with. Every page is yours to customize, whether you want to type, draw, add stickers, record audio, collect scanned objects, save special songs, and more, to remember and preserve your story.

What you can do in Aurem-

* Design a cover. There is a library of materials including leathers, animal prints, lace, cowhide, and more (or you can upload your own). Add your name, choose your stickers and add ons. Create your own stickers or choose from the library.
* Write how you want. Type in your favorite font from the library, upload your own font file, or upload your own handwriting and type with it. You can also record a voice memo, or draw and write freehand with your finger or Apple Pencil.
* Personalize entries. Add a song of the day to remember, attached straight from Spotify or via a URL.
* Add a daily mood emoji to capture how you're feeling.
* Pick your page paper. Cream, ivory, blush, ledger, dotted, lined, blank, your own upload and more.
* Decorate entries. Add pressed flowers, photo polaroids, stickers, drawings, and more.
* Keep everything organized. Search past entries, browse by month and day, save favorites into collections, export PDFs of your journal.
* Save special moments. Add a bookmark ribbon where you want to save a place, dog-ear special pages, press special quotes and find them in the appendix.

Aurem keeps words, however vulnerable, photos, drawings, recordings, music and more.
Your daily record, made unique to you, because your story is unique and worth preserving.
Designed for iPhone and iPad.
Terms of Use: https://www.auremjournal.com/terms

results.releaseNotes:

Also includes improvements to month-end dates, scheduled payment amounts and account-assignment warnings.
results.description:
Aurem Finance is a private, all-in-one money and retirement planner that runs entirely on your device. No accounts. No tracking. No servers. Your financial life stays with you.

Build a monthly plan, see your true cash runway, attack debt, and answer the big question — "am I on track to retire?" — all in one place.

BUDGET & CASH FLOW
• Plan each month's income, bills, and spending with a clear cash-flow forecast.
• A month-first bills view of what's actually due — searchable and sortable, with fixed vs. variable and set-aside amounts for non-monthly bills.
• Month-End Close wizard to wrap up each month in five guided steps.
• Net worth tracking and spending insights over time.

DEBT
• Loan and mortgage payoff using real term and start date for an exact debt-free date.
• See how extra payments cut months and interest.

RETIREMENT
• Projected balance, inflation-adjusted readiness, and Coast FIRE — for you and your spouse individually.
• Drawdown projection you can steer by dollars or by withdrawal rate.
• Monte Carlo success rate, retire-age chart, Roth conversion ladder, and Social Security tools.
• See your plan with and without Social Security.

FEES & INVESTING
• Fee Drag calculator that itemizes an advisor's real cost and flags when it's high.
• Low-cost model portfolios by time horizon and an editable portfolio guide.

ASK AUREM — ON-DEVICE AI (Pro)

MADE FOR EVERY DEVICE

PRIVACY BY DEFAULT
• No account and no sign-up. Your data lives on your device.
• Widget amounts hidden and reminder details masked by default.
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID lock and encrypted backups.
• Export your data anytime — it's always yours, and export is free.

Aurem Pro unlocks Ask Aurem and advanced planning tools.

Aurem provides educational budgeting and planning tools only. It is not a licensed financial, tax, or investment advisor, and nothing in the app is personalized investment advice. Consult a qualified professional before making financial decisions.

— Subscription —
Aurem Pro is an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the period's end. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

results.releaseNotes:
Much faster in busy places
A scan in a hotel, an airport or an apartment block can turn up hundreds of devices, and the app slowed to a crawl and drained the battery when it did. That is fixed: results stay smooth however many devices are found, and a long scan costs far less power.

A more honest verdict
The verdict at the end of a scan sometimes warned that local-network scanning had not run when it had, which made a real warning easy to ignore. It now reports only what actually happened during that scan.

Display fixes
Threat levels no longer wrap awkwardly next to long device names, and the app keeps its dark appearance instead of washing out on devices set to Light Mode.
results.description:
Worried someone is watching or following you? Hidden Device Radar helps you find hidden cameras, trackers, and unknown smart devices — right from your iPhone.

Whether you're checking a hotel room, a short-term rental, an office, a car, or your own home, Hidden Device Radar gives you a fast, private way to spot devices that may be recording or tracking you.

WHAT IT DETECTS
• Bluetooth devices — trackers (AirTag, Tile, SmartTag, Chipolo), cameras, speakers, wearables, and other IoT gadgets
• Wi-Fi / local network devices — IP cameras, baby monitors, NVRs, doorbells, and smart-home hardware
• Unknown trackers that may be traveling with you
• NFC tags — tap to identify a chip hidden in an object (on supported iPhones)

KEY FEATURES
• Real-time threat scoring — every device is flagged as Info, Suspicious, Elevated, or Critical
• Signal Strength Finder — a "warmer / colder" proximity graph that helps you physically locate a device (Pro)
• Scan modes for a quick sweep, a single room, or a whole floor
• Detailed device fingerprints and manufacturer identification
• Detection history so you can tell what's new versus what's always there
• 100% on-device — your scans never leave your iPhone. No account, no tracking, no ads.

HIDDEN DEVICE RADAR PRO
Unlock everything with a one-time purchase:
• Signal Strength Finder
• NFC Tap-to-Identify
• Full threat analysis and guidance
• Unlimited detection history
• AI Trend Insight

HONEST ABOUT LIMITATIONS
Hidden Device Radar detects devices that broadcast Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or NFC signals. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and NFC advertisements are unauthenticated, so results are strong investigative leads — not legal proof of a device's identity or intent. The app cannot detect devices that are powered off, purely analog/wired, or that broadcast no signal.

PRIVACY FIRST
Everything runs locally on your device. We don't collect, upload, or sell your data. There are no accounts and no ads.

Use Hidden Device Radar to check your own spaces and protect your own privacy. Always follow the laws in your area.

Ember is a companion that lives entirely on your phone.

No account. No cloud. No server has ever seen a word you've said — because Ember doesn't have one.


TALK, DON'T TYPE

Start a hands-free conversation and just speak. Ember listens, thinks, and answers out loud in her own voice — then listens again. Pause when you need to. Interrupt her when you want to. It's meant to feel like talking to someone, not operating an app.


SHE REMEMBERS

Ember carries what you tell her. Mention a hard week on Tuesday and she'll ask how it landed on Thursday. Over time she notices what keeps coming back — the patterns you're too close to see yourself.


SIX WAYS TO BE MET

Choose the presence that fits how you want to be heard:

• The Sage — patterns, meaning, the longer view
• The Coach — direct, energizing, focused on the next step
• The Confidant — patient, gentle, never in a hurry
• The Analyst — precise and observant; logic with heart
• The Muse — creative reframes and unexpected angles
• The Companion — casual, warm, honest like a good friend

Each one writes differently, sounds different out loud, and even moves differently on screen.


A LETTER EVERY WEEK

Once a week Ember writes you a short letter about your week — what recurred, what lifted, what you might have forgotten you said. Read it yourself, or have her read it to you.


BUILT ON APPLE INTELLIGENCE

Ember thinks using Apple's on-device foundation model. That's exactly why she can be genuinely responsive and still never send anything anywhere.


ALSO INSIDE

• Mood check-ins that take ten seconds
• Habit tracking with streaks
• A searchable vault of everything you've shared
• Optional Health context — so a short night can explain a heavy day
• Optional gentle reminders, timed to when you usually show up
• Export everything as a file, or delete all of it, in one tap


EMBER PRO — $4.99 ONCE

Unlimited habits instead of three. Search your vault by meaning rather than keywords, including by voice. Keep every memory active, blend two personalities into a single voice, and map every connection in your constellation. One payment. No subscription, ever.


A NOTE ON WHAT EMBER IS

Ember is a companion for reflection and self-understanding. It is not a medical device, and it does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or mental-health treatment. If you are in crisis, please contact your local emergency number or a crisis line.


REQUIREMENTS

Ember's conversational replies use Apple Intelligence, available on iPhone 15 Pro and later running iOS 26. On other supported devices Ember still works — check-ins, habits, memory, voice, and letters — with simpler written responses.

results.releaseNotes:
Know why, not just what
Every watering, planting, and harvest reminder has a "Why this task?" link showing the frost dates, planting windows, days to maturity, recent rain, and bed conditions behind it. Disagree with any of it? Change it.

34 new flowers
Spring bulbs (tulip, daffodil, crocus, hyacinth, allium, lily), native perennials (cardinal flower, wild bergamot, blazing star, Joe Pye weed, milkweed), garden classics (peony, bearded iris, hosta, astilbe, Russian sage), and easy annuals (impatiens, geranium, lantana, celosia). Fall bulbs are scheduled for autumn planting.

Reminders that arrive, and make sense
Watering and harvest reminders now fire on schedule, and seed reminders warn you before sowing day when a packet is missing, low, or too old. Rain is counted over two days, so a wet yesterday and a drizzle today means one clear answer: "1.08 in. rain yesterday and today, watering paused until Thursday."

Reminders tuned to each bed
Record mulch, irrigation, soil, and sun for every bed. Watering intervals account for thirsty crops, drip lines, sandy soil, and shade.

Missed something? No problem
Mark a late task done, postpone it, skip it, or record that weather prevented it.

Succession planting and crop rotation
Keep lettuce, beans, and radishes coming, with the next sowing moved up when you log a harvest. Beds keep a year-by-year crop history and warn when a plant family returns too soon.

Pest and disease log
Record a problem with a photo and symptom checklist, see likely matches for that plant, then track every treatment and whether it worked.

Harvest insights
Record the variety you grew and see which yields best per plant, plus totals by crop type and CSV export.

Pollinators and native plants
Mark a bed as a pollinator bed for spring-to-fall bloom coverage, butterfly host plants, and plants native to your region. Pest advice includes bee-safe spray timing.

Seasonal journal
Several photos per entry, browsing by season, and year-over-year comparisons.

Lock Screen widgets
Watering tasks, your next harvest, and the frost countdown at a glance.

Frost protection
When frost is forecast, see which plantings are tender, which beds they're in, and what to do before dark.

Apple Intelligence
On supported iPhones and iPads, AI runs privately on your device with no API key, and can lay out a bed and place the plants for you. Your own Claude or OpenAI key still works as a fallback.

Light and dark
Choose System, Light, or Dark in Settings.

Also improved
Guided setup for zone, frost dates, beds, and crops. Editable seed packets. Established fruit trees and perennials now show their real cropping season instead of counting from the planting date.

results.releaseNotes:
NEW: NEXT SERVICE WIDGET
Put your garage on your home screen. The new widget shows what's due next
across your vehicles, with overdue and due-soon counts at a glance — in
small and medium sizes. It updates automatically as you log services and
mileage. Included free.

NEW FOR PRO: IS THIS REPAIR WORTH IT?
Facing a big repair bill? The new Repair Advisor answers the question
everyone asks. Enter the quote and it shows what keeping the vehicle
actually costs per month over the next year — factoring in work you've
previously declined, your spending trend, and maintenance already on the
horizon — then compares that to a typical replacement payment.

It's built as a decision aid, not a verdict. Safety-critical repairs like
brakes, steering, and open recalls are called out separately, because
those aren't a cost-benefit call.

ALSO IN THIS RELEASE
• Add an estimated value to any vehicle to compare repairs against what
  it's worth
• Faster, more reliable launches
• Stability and performance improvements throughout

Thanks for using Vehicle Care IQ. Questions or ideas? We read everything.
